results.title: King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard Announce New Album Alien Metal
results.content:
King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard have announced their new album, Alien Metal.
Alien Metal, their 28th studio album, will be released later this summer on their own p(doom) records.
King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard’s previous album was 2025’s Phantom Island.
